verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine with public docs, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack shows no llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation, and a probe for a markdown docs variant (Edge0.md) returned HTTP 404. The OpenAI-compatible serve endpoint is a different capability and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
